dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convex reduction in width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity off-white to very light grey skin tone consistent across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a small, bright white high-contrast spot on the right posterior margin; several low-contrast, thin linear parallel marks on the mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear rake marks on the mid-dorsal surface and a focal white scar or pigment loss on the lower right side.
other_distinctive_markers: Aperture of the blowhole is visible as a high-contrast dark circular feature on the anterior midline.
